result.title: Fast Rates for Offline Q-Learning with KL Regularization
result.summary: This paper investigates offline Q-learning for finite-horizon Markov decision processes with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. Recent studies have shown that KL regularization can yield fast rates in offline decision-making problems. However, it remains unclear whether Q-learning, which adopts incremental stochastic approximation updates, can achieve such fast rates in the offline setting. We first propose KL-regularized Q-Learning (KLQ), a simple variant of classical Q-learning. By exploiting KL regularization, we prove that KLQ achieves a sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}(1/ε)$ without explicit pessimism. This guarantee, however, has an exponential dependence on the KL regularization parameter and the horizon. To address this limitation, we further propose KL-regularized Pessimistic Q-Learning (KLPQ), which incorporates pessimism into KLQ. We prove that KLPQ retains the same \(\widetilde O(1/ε)\) rate while removing the explicit exponential dependence, thereby further improving the sample complexity. To the best of our knowledge, these results establish the first fast-rate guarantees for offline Q-learning in tabular finite-horizon KL-regularized MDPs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究有限时域 MDP 的离线 Q-learning：先提出 KL 正则化 Q-learning（KLQ），证明无需显式悲观即可达到 Õ(1/ε) 样本复杂度；再提出加入悲观性的 KLPQ，在保留该速率的同时消除对 KL 参数与时域的指数依赖。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属离线强化学习理论，与视觉推理无直接关联；其「KL 正则化使增量式随机逼近更新获得快速率」的分析，可能为 LVR 中循环状态更新的稳定性、轨迹训练正则化与样本效率设计提供可供核查的方法线索。
